title: Sunflower
description: A bold yellow sunflower with a dark seed head against an almost uniform deep-blue sky, so a few clusters give clean, flat petal, centre, leaf and sky layers.
author: Cbuske46

title: Blue Ridge Sunset
description: Overlapping mountain ridges fade from near-black to pale violet under a pink sunset sky, giving natural tone bands that map directly onto stacked paper layers.
author: U.S. National Park Service (Shenandoah National Park)

title: Red Fox
description: A sharply focused orange fox with white chest and dark legs stands against a soft blurred blue background, so its outline separates cleanly from the backdrop.
author: Ray Hennessy
